headline: DSK Legal acts on Uno Minda - Inovance Automotive JV
sum: Uno Minda Limited has secured the approval under Press Note 3 (PN3) from the Government of India for its proposed joint venture with Inovance Automotive. The proposed investee, Uno Minda Auto Innovations Pvt.
detail: Uno Minda Limited has secured the approval under Press Note 3 (PN3) from the Government of India for its proposed joint venture with Inovance Automotive. The proposed investee, Uno Minda Auto Innovations Pvt. Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Uno Minda incorporated specifically for the joint venture, received investment from Inovance Automotive (HK), a subsidiary of China’s Suzhou Inovance Automotive. DSK Legal advised and represented Uno Minda on this transaction.
